appearance.body: Apply a real desktop theme now. You can adjust it at any time in Settings.
appearance.enhancedContrastHint: Strengthen text, borders, and selected controls.
appearance.preview.message: This preview reflects your display choices.
appearance.preview.subtitle: A sample PICOM space
appearance.scaleApplyFailed: PICOM could not apply that interface scale. Your current scale is unchanged.
appearance.strongFocusHint: Make keyboard focus easier to see.
appearance.title: Choose your appearance
audioVideo.body: Choose voice devices, then optionally check your camera and screen sharing locally. Access is requested only when you choose to enable it.
audioVideo.detailBody: Device choices remain available from the relevant voice and video settings when you need them.
audioVideo.detailTitle: Your control stays with the feature
audioVideo.deviceChanged: A selected device changed. PICOM safely switched to an available device.
audioVideo.error.busy: The selected microphone is busy in another application. Close that application, then try again.
audioVideo.error.outputRouting: This runtime can only play the test sound through the system default output.
audioVideo.error.permission: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in system settings, then try again.
audioVideo.error.unavailable: The selected audio device is unavailable. PICOM can use an available device instead.
audioVideo.error.unknown: PICOM could not complete that audio action. Try again.
audioVideo.error.unsupported: Audio device setup is not supported in this runtime.
audioVideo.localOnly: The microphone test stays on this device. Audio is not recorded, saved, or sent anywhere.
audioVideo.noMicrophoneBody: Connect a microphone or choose a different system input, then try again.
audioVideo.permissionBlockedBody: PICOM cannot use a microphone until access is allowed. Check your system privacy settings, then try again.
audioVideo.permissionBody: PICOM needs microphone access for voice calls. It will only request audio access after you choose Enable microphone.
audioVideo.speaker: Speaker
audioVideo.systemDefaultBody: Your system chooses where test sound plays in this runtime.
audioVideo.title: Set up audio and video
audioVideo.unavailableBody: This PICOM runtime cannot access audio devices. You can continue and configure them later in a supported desktop environment.
camera.body: Choose a camera and open a local preview before a video call.
camera.deviceChanged: The selected camera changed. Review the available camera before starting a new preview.
camera.error.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in system settings, then try again.
camera.error.inUse: The selected camera is busy in another application. Close that application, then try again.
camera.error.unavailable: The selected camera is unavailable. Choose an available camera, then start a new preview.
camera.error.unknown: PICOM could not open the selected camera. Try again.
camera.error.unsupported: Camera setup is not supported in this runtime.
camera.inUseBody: The selected camera is busy in another application. Close that application, then try again.
camera.localOnly: The camera preview stays local. Video is not recorded, saved, or sent anywhere.
camera.permissionBlockedBody: PICOM cannot use a camera until access is allowed. Check your system privacy settings, then try again.
camera.permissionBody: PICOM requests video access only after you choose Enable camera. The preview stays on this device.
camera.title: Check your camera
camera.unavailableBody: Connect a camera or choose a different video device, then try again.
camera.unsupportedBody: This runtime cannot access cameras. You can configure one later in a supported desktop environment.
desktop.body: Choose how PICOM starts, closes, and opens on this device. Changes apply immediately.
desktop.closeDescription: The title-bar close button and the native window close action always use this same choice.
desktop.closeQuitHint: Close the PICOM process when the main window closes.
desktop.closeTray: Keep PICOM running in system tray
desktop.closeTrayHint: Hide the window and restore the same PICOM session from the tray.
desktop.destinationDescription: Only a high-level area is remembered. PICOM never stores a private conversation or message here.
desktop.destinationLastHint: Restore the last safe area on this device.
desktop.destinationMessagesHint: Open the generic Messages landing, not a private conversation.
desktop.detailBody: Window and startup choices remain available in Settings when you decide to change them.
desktop.error.preferenceUpdate: PICOM could not save that desktop preference. Your previous setting is still in use.
desktop.error.startupUpdate: PICOM could not update the operating system startup setting.
desktop.launchAtStartup: Launch PICOM when I sign in
desktop.launchAtStartupHint: PICOM confirms this with your operating system before showing it as enabled.
desktop.startupDescription: Use the operating system's real sign-in setting when it is available.
desktop.startupDevUnavailable: Launch at sign-in is available only in a packaged PICOM desktop build.
desktop.startupNormalHint: Show the main window after you sign in to your computer.
desktop.startupTrayHint: Keep the window hidden only for a system-started PICOM session.
desktop.startupUnavailable: PICOM could not read the operating system startup setting. Try again later.
desktop.startupUnsupported: Launch at sign-in is not supported on this platform.
desktop.startupVisibilityHint: A manual PICOM launch still opens its window normally.
desktop.title: Keep the desktop on your terms
desktop.trayUnavailable: The system tray is unavailable in this runtime, so closing PICOM will quit safely.
notifications.body: Choose when PICOM may draw your attention. Permission is requested only after you explicitly choose it in a browser runtime.
notifications.browserFallbackHint: This runtime uses the browser notification permission when it is available.
notifications.desktopBody: PICOM uses the notification capability that this desktop runtime actually provides.
notifications.detailBody: Notification preferences can be reviewed in Settings before delivery is enabled.
notifications.focusBody: Quiet hours and Do Not Disturb suppress desktop interruptions without changing your category choices.
notifications.notifyBody: These are your account notification preferences. You can refine them later in Settings.
notifications.permissionFailed: PICOM could not enable notification permission.
notifications.preset.recommendedHint: Messages, mentions, calls, friend requests, and community activity.
notifications.systemControlledHint: PICOM can request native notifications. Your operating system controls whether and how they are presented.
notifications.testBody: Your desktop notifications are ready for testing.
notifications.testFailed: PICOM could not send the test notification.
notifications.title: Choose notification delivery deliberately
personalize.body: Choose one or more ways you plan to use PICOM. These choices only shape this first-run setup on this device.
personalize.helper: You can change these settings later. They are not saved as account interests.
personalize.multiSelectHint: You can choose more than one.
personalize.purposes.communities.title: Communities
personalize.purposes.creator.body: Camera, microphone, screen sharing, and community communication.
personalize.purposes.creator.title: Creator & streaming
personalize.purposes.friends.body: Direct messages and voice or video calls.
personalize.purposes.friends.title: Friends & communication
personalize.purposes.gaming.body: Voice, device setup, screen sharing, and desktop use while you play.
personalize.purposes.gaming.title: Gaming
personalize.purposes.work.body: Team communication, calls, notifications, and desktop behavior.
personalize.purposes.work.title: Work & team
personalize.reviewAllHint: Include every setup area in this guided flow.
personalize.title: How will you use PICOM?
privacy.accountChanged: The signed-in account changed. Privacy settings were reloaded.
privacy.accountOwned: These settings apply only to the signed-in account on this device.
privacy.body: These choices belong to your PICOM account. They are not stored as device preferences.
privacy.deferredBody: Account privacy can be changed only after you sign in. This device setup will not invent or save privacy choices.
privacy.detailBody: Review privacy choices after sign-in when you are ready to manage your account.
privacy.dm.everyoneHint: Anyone who is not blocked can start or continue a direct message.
privacy.dm.friendsHint: Only accepted friends can start or continue a direct message.
privacy.dm.hint: This applies to new conversations and to messages in existing threads. Blocked people stay blocked.
privacy.dm.label: Direct messages
privacy.dm.noOneHint: Other people cannot start or continue a direct message to you.
privacy.existingKept: Your existing preferences will be kept until you change them here.
privacy.friendRequests.communityMembersH: Only people who share a community with you can send a request.
privacy.friendRequests.everyoneHint: Anyone on PICOM can send a friend request.
privacy.friendRequests.friendsOfFriendsH: Only people who share a mutual friend can send a request.
privacy.friendRequests.hint: Controls who can send you a new friend request. Existing community access stays the same.
privacy.friendRequests.label: Friend requests
privacy.friendRequests.nobodyHint: New friend requests are declined by the account policy.
privacy.presence.hideHint: Other people do not receive a visible online status from this account.
privacy.presence.hint: Controls whether other people receive your active status.
privacy.presence.label: Online presence
privacy.presence.showHint: People who can see your presence receive your active status.
privacy.profile.everyoneHint: People who can open your profile see the details you keep visible.
privacy.profile.friendsHint: Only accepted friends can see those profile details.
privacy.profile.hint: Display name, username, and avatar stay visible. This choice controls details such as bio, activity, communities, and media.
privacy.profile.label: Profile visibility
privacy.profile.sharedCommunitiesHint: People who share a community with you can see those profile details.
privacy.safety.blockHint: Stops the selected person from contacting you or seeing your activity according to existing block rules.
privacy.safety.body: Block, mute, and report stay available after setup. They are not configured on this step.
privacy.safety.muteHint: Quiets notifications from a conversation without blocking the person.
privacy.safety.reportHint: Sends a safety report for review by PICOM.
privacy.title: Choose who can reach you

ready.changeLater: You can change these settings later.
ready.speaker: Speaker
ready.title: PICOM is ready for you.
